goal: SlotGuard helps local service businesses cut no-show losses by collecting a small refundable deposit at booking time. Owners get a booking link and a simple dashboard; clients see clear cancel rules. This canvas is the first pass: booking, deposits, refunds, and owner visibility. Pricing, payment provider, and deposit rules are still open.
summary:
SlotGuard is a deposit protection and scheduling app designed for local service businesses to reduce no-show losses.
I built a complete working app featuring public booking with transparent deposit policies, mock payment checkout with real-time audit logs, an owner dashboard with deposit state management (mark no-show, complete, refund), services/deposit rules settings, and simulated email/SMS notification outbox.
Decisions for open canvas questions (SaaS pricing model, 25%/24h deposit policy, mock payment provider, synchronous concurrency control) are fully documented on the `/about` page.
